title: Identity-bound roll-call reset in service layer
description: project-LICHEN-worker6-w063 mitigated id-reset list-wiping at the resource layer (counts restored after lichen_rollcall_post). Proper fix: record creator identity (source address) on struct lichen_rollcall in lichen/checkin.c and only wipe responded/missing when re-POST comes from the creator — requires extending the oracle-matched service API and test/vectors/checkin_rollcall.json (Python oracle) in lockstep.
close_reason: Creator identity bound at creation: struct lichen_rollcall gains has_creator/creator (LICHEN_ROLLCALL_CREATOR_MAX 46, peer IPv6 text via net_addr_ntop in the resource layer). New lichen_rollcall_post_ex(): creator re-post of a known id updates started/timeout and PRESERVES responded/missing; non-creator (including NULL-vs-known) gets LICHEN_CHECKIN_CODE_FORBIDDEN (4.03) with LICHEN_CHECKIN_ERR_CREATOR_MISMATCH detail; legacy 4-arg lichen_rollcall_post wraps _ex with NULL creator so vector/host-suite semantics are unchanged. Resource handler passes the peer-derived identity and its restore-hack is removed. Twister qemu_x86/atom 9/9 (new test_rollcall_repost_creator_binding); host suite lichen/tests/checkin_rollcall green under ASan/UBSan.
